bio:
Ekaterina Sycheva is an award-winning graphic designer specializing in brand identity, visual communication, and poster design. Her work has received international design awards and has been exhibited across the United States, Europe, Asia, and Latin America.

With nearly a decade of professional experience, she also contributes to the design community as a competition juror, lecturer, educator, and author of professional articles on graphic design.
seoDescription: Ekaterina Sycheva is an award-winning graphic designer whose work spans brand identity, poster design, international exhibitions, and design education.
